mapper.select: SELECT id, public_id AS publicId, tenant_id AS tenantId, user_code AS userCode, username, nickname, employee_id AS employeeId, user_type AS userType, status, mobile, email, remark FROM iam_user WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT r.role_name FROM iam_role r INNER JOIN iam_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0
